contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [D N VALENTINI-AN VS] P F AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS-[REI PVBLICAE]

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of Valentinian I (A.D. 364-375), dating to the period A.D. 364-367 (Reece Period 19). SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE reverse type, depicting Victory walking left, holding wreath and palm. Mint illegible. Obverse description: Pearl-diademed bust of the emperor, right, draped and cuirassed. Obverse inscription: [D N VALENTINI-AN VS] P F AVG. Reverse description: Victory…
